title: HEAR, SEE, SPIKE ONCE: Highly Efficient NeuroAI Temporal Neural Networks for Low-Precision Multimodal Audio-Visual Classification and Online Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.31884v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Spiking neural networks for multimodal audio-visual classification reach high accuracy by adopting deep-learning machinery: multi-stage convolutional or transformer encoders trained end-to-end with surrogate-gradient backpropagation through time. These prior works typically rely on full-precision (32-bit) parameters and do not treat hardware efficiency as a primary design objective. In this paper, we propose NeuTNN-AV, a much simpler hardware-amenable multimodal substrate built on the recently proposed NeuroAI Temporal Neural Network (NeuTNN) and demonstrate that it can match or outperform state-of-the-art SNN baselines with a fraction of their synapse counts. NeuTNN neurons carry multiple active dendritic segments. Each input line spikes at most once (temporal coding) and every weight is learned via a local reward-modulated spike-timing dependent plasticity (STDP) rule. All weights are 4-bit integers and inference uses only comparisons

translated_title: 听、看、单次脉冲：用于低精度多模态视听分类与在线学习的高效神经AI时序神经网络
translated_abstract: 面向多模态视听分类的脉冲神经网络（SNN）通常通过采用深度学习机制来达到高精度：即采用多阶段卷积或Transformer编码器，并通过时间维度上的代理梯度反向传播进行端到端训练。这些先前的工作通常依赖于全精度（32位）参数，且并未将硬件效率作为主要设计目标。在本文中，我们提出了NeuTNN-AV，这是一个基于近期提出的神经AI时序神经网络（NeuTNN）构建的、结构更简单且适合硬件实现的多模态计算基底，并证明它能够以仅占基线一小部分的突触数量，达到与最先进SNN基线相当或更优的性能。NeuTNN神经元携带多个活跃的树突段。每条输入线路最多只发放一次脉冲（时间编码），每个权重均通过局部的奖励调制脉冲时序依赖可塑性（STDP）规则进行学习。所有权重均为4位整数，推理过程仅使用比较操作。
tldr: 本文提出NeuTNN-AV，一种采用单次脉冲时间编码、4位整数权重和局部奖励调制STDP学习规则的高效多模态视听神经网络，能够以远少于现有SNN的突触数量达到相当或更优的分类精度。
en_tdlr: NeuTNN-AV, a highly efficient multimodal audio-visual neural network featuring single-spike temporal coding, 4-bit integer weights, and local reward-modulated STDP learning, matches or outperforms state-of-the-art SNN baselines with only a fraction of their synapse counts.
